meta.parties: In the Matter of the Last Will and Testament of L. Carolis Dias, Deceased

rules.statement: In the case of a petition for proof of a will, if an order nisi is made and issues are framed under section 533, the Court can discharge the order nisi if it appears that the prima facie proof of the material allegations has not been rebutted.
rules.supporting_quote: "Held, per Bonser, C.J - (1) The word 'rebutted' in the above section does not refer to the trial of the issues, but to the final result of the proceedings."
